content: The Wilds evolve with the massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, coming in 2027! A giant dragon's sudden siege heralds change in the Forbidden Lands, for both land and sky. Bracing for danger, the Expedition steels themselves as familiar and undiscovered Elder Dragons emerge - and a disturbing new threat prowls the land. Official website https://www.monsterhunter.com/wilds-ascendance/en-us/ Wishlist now on Steam https://bit.ly/MHWAsteam *Footage represents a game still in development. The main Monster Hunter Wilds game is required to play Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance. About Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in 2027 on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, and PC.
